attributes.name: Cecilla the Uprooter
attributes.powers:
When you encounter a bane that may not be evaded, recharge this card to evade it or to add 1d4 to your checks to defeat it.

Bury this card to explore your location. During this exploration, you may evade any monster you encounter.
